hostname rt-p01
!
crypto ikev2 proposal IKEV2-PROP-SAMPLE
 encryption aes-cbc-256 aes-cbc-128
 integrity sha256 sha1
 group 14 5
!
crypto ikev2 policy IKEV2-POL-SAMPLE
 proposal IKEV2-PROP-SAMPLE
!
crypto ikev2 keyring IKEV2-KEYS-SAMPLE
 peer sample-peer-b
  address 203.0.113.30
  pre-shared-key dummy-psk-sample-b
!
crypto ikev2 profile IKEV2-PROF-SAMPLE-B
 match identity remote address 203.0.113.30 255.255.255.255
 authentication remote pre-share
 authentication local pre-share
 keyring local IKEV2-KEYS-SAMPLE
!
crypto isakmp policy 10
 encryption aes 256
 hash sha256
 authentication pre-share
 group 14
crypto isakmp policy 20
 encryption aes
 hash sha
 authentication pre-share
 group 2
crypto isakmp key dummy-psk-sample-a address 203.0.113.20
!
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-SAMPLE-1 esp-aes 256 esp-sha-hmac
crypto ipsec transform-set TS-SAMPLE-2 esp-aes esp-sha-hmac
!
crypto ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE-B
 set transform-set TS-SAMPLE-1 TS-SAMPLE-2
 set ikev2-profile IKEV2-PROF-SAMPLE-B
!
crypto map CMAP-SAMPLE 10 ipsec-isakmp
 set peer 203.0.113.20
 set transform-set TS-SAMPLE-1 TS-SAMPLE-2
 set pfs group14
 match address ACL-SAMPLE-A
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description sample-wan
 ip address 203.0.113.9 255.255.255.248
 crypto map CMAP-SAMPLE
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description sample-lan
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.128
!
interface Tunnel1
 ip address 198.51.100.249 255.255.255.252
 tunnel source GigabitEthernet0/0
 tunnel mode ipsec ipv4
 tunnel destination 203.0.113.30
 tunnel protection ipsec policy ipv4 ACL-SAMPLE-B
 tunnel protection ipsec profile PROF-SAMPLE-B
!
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.14
ip route 198.51.100.128 255.255.255.128 Tunnel1
!
ip access-list extended ACL-SAMPLE-A
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 198.51.100.0 0.0.0.127
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 host 198.51.100.200
ip access-list extended ACL-SAMPLE-B
 permit ip 192.0.2.0 0.0.0.127 198.51.100.128 0.0.0.127
!
end
